|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Summon Skitterbots''' is a [[skill]] which [[mana reservation|reserves mana]] to summon two invulnerable Skitterbot [[minion]]s. The Skitterbots search for [[trap]]s and [[mine]]s you have laid and trigger/detonate some of them if an enemy is within targeting range. Mines detonated by Skitterbots are re-armed to detonate a second time. One Skitterbot has an [[aura]] that [[chill]]s nearby enemies and the other has an aura that [[shock]]s nearby enemies. Skitterbots grant more trap and mine damage to the owner. ==Skill functions and interactions== * The [[Chill]] and [[Shock]] effects of this skill makes Summon Skitterbots a versatile defensive/offensive option for many builds, not just mine/trap-focused builds. * Even though the Skitterbots are invulnerable, they can deal damage over time to nearby monsters when supported by {{il|Infernal Legion Support}}, also enabling the use of {{c|mod|against Burning Enemies}} stats. * Each Skitterbot has a 3 second cooldown after activating a [[trap]] or [[mine]]. * Skitterbots cannot be summoned while wearing {{il|The Primordial Chain}} due to the "{{ml|CannotHaveNonGolemMinionsUnique__1_|display=stat_text}}" modifier. * Skitterbots can be supported by {{il|Meat Shield Support}}, causing them to be defensive and stay relatively close to the player instead of actively seeking nearby enemies. * The skill is an aura skill, but since it does not cast an aura on the player and instead summons two minions with auras, this skill does not count towards the number of [[Aura|Auras]] a player has. This is especially useful for builds that utilize mechanics that limit the number of [[Aura|Auras]] a player can have. * Skitterbots are untargetable and are never considered nearby allies or minions for effects like {{il|Haste}}, {{il|Summon Carrion Golem}}, {{il|Rallying Cry}}, or {{c|mod|While there are at least # nearby Allies...}} modifiers.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/e7hg0u/ggg_can_we_have_skitterbots_count_as_minioms_for/fa0ym6f/ * {{il|Companionship Support}}: Skitterbots counted as minion, so that it will deactivate that support gem when linking that gem to minion skill other than Skitterbots AND turned on Skitterbots at the same time, due to the gem mod {{c|mod|if they are your only Minion}}. ===Chilling & Shocking Auras=== *The Chilling Skitterbot applies a base [[Chill]] effect causing '''10% reduced [[action speed]]'''. *The Shocking Skitterbot applies a base [[Shock]] effect causing '''15% increased damage taken'''. **The Skitterbots' [[Chill|Chilling]] and [[Shock|Shocking]] [[Aura|Auras]] are a property of the Skitterbot minions, not the player. ***The Chilling and Shocking auras do not benefit from [[modifiers]] affecting player [[Aura|Auras]] like {{c|mod|Increased Effect of Non-Curse Auras}} or {{c|mod|Increased Area of Effect of Non-Curse Auras}}. ***The Chilling and Shocking auras do not benefit from modifiers affecting player shock/chill effect like {{c|mod|Increased Effect of Chill}}, {{c|mod|Increased Effect of Shock}}, or {{c|mod|Increased Effect of Non-Damaging Ailments}}. https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3284453 ***The Chilling and Shocking auras ''will'' benefit from modifiers such as {{c|mod|Increased Effect of Chill}}, {{c|mod|Increased Effect of Shock}}, or {{c|mod|Increased Effect of Non-Damaging Ailments}} that are applied to the Skitterbot minions with support gems such as [[Unbound Ailments Support]] or [[Bonechill Support]], with the downside of increasing the skill's reservation. **'''Summon Skitterbots'''' inherent {{c|mod|Minions have (0-19)% increased Chill Effect}} or {{c|mod|Minions have (0-19)% increased Shock Effect}} will increase the effect of the Skitterbots' Chilling and Shocking auras. * The base aura radius is 3.0 Speed |c3_header = x increased Minion Movement Speed |c3_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% increased Minion Movement Speed |c3_pattern_value = %d%% }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Ruthless mode== Summon Skitterbots cannot be obtained from [[quest]]s or traded for using an {{il|Uncarved Gemstone}} through [[Siosa]] in [[Ruthless mode]]. {{Skill enchantment modifier list |query= mods.generation_type=10 AND mod_spawn_weights.tag = "helmet" AND mod_spawn_weights.value > 0 AND mods.id LIKE "%Skitterbots%" }} ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Summon Skitterbots: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where = items.stat_text LIKE "%Skitterbot%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.9.2b| * No longer targetable in PvP. }} {{Version history table row|3.9.0| * The default Shock magnitude for effects that apply Shock without damage (such as '''Skitterbots''') is now 15% (from 20%). }} {{Version history table row|3.8.1| * {{il|Burning Damage Support}} and {{il|Elemental Focus Support}} can now support '''Summon Skitterbots''' while it is also supported by {{il|Infernal Legion Support|Infernal Legion}}. }} {{Version history table row|3.8.0d| * '''Skitterbots''', when supported by {{il|Infernal Legion Support|Infernal Legion}}, now deal damage over time to nearby monsters. }} {{Version history table row|3.8.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
